Share of people employed in agricultural.descriptionShort: The share of people employed in agriculture includes working-age people with a job in farming, forestry, fishing, and related activities, including those temporarily absent.
descriptionKey: This measures the percentage of all workers who are employed in agriculture.
Agriculture includes farming, forestry, fishing, and related activities.
People are counted even if they are temporarily absent from work due to sickness, leave, or seasonal factors.
